description: This file implements an HTTP transport wrapper for OpenTelemetry instrumentation, adding tracing and metrics to outbound HTTP requests.

classes.name: Transport
classes.description: A custom HTTP RoundTripper that adds OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics to outbound HTTP requests.

methods.name: NewTransport
methods.description: Creates a new Transport wrapping the provided http.RoundTripper with tracing and metrics capabilities.

methods.name: applyConfig
methods.description: Applies configuration settings to the Transport instance.

methods.name: defaultTransportFormatter
methods.description: Default function to format span names based on HTTP method.

methods.name: RoundTrip
methods.description: Performs an HTTP round trip with tracing, metrics, and context propagation.

methods.name: metricAttributesFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts additional metric attributes from the HTTP request.

methods.name: newWrappedBody
methods.description: Wraps the response body to record metrics and span status.
